description: Cumulative spend limits per project. A project absent from this file has NO budget, which means every spend request for it is denied — budget is granted explicitly, never by default. Amounts are in the stated currency; the daily period is computed in the stated IANA timezone, never the server's implicit local time.
hierarchy: REQUEST — a single spend request may never exceed request_limit
MISSION — cumulative spend of one mission may never exceed mission_limit
PROJECT/DAY — cumulative spend of the project in its period may never exceed daily_limit
POLICY — the policy engine's own per-request threshold and class rules
A request must pass EVERY applicable boundary; the strictest wins and no lower scope can widen a higher one.

mythos-prod.note: Zero by owner default: the orchestration project performs no paid external actions. Raising any of these is an owner decision recorded in Git.

budget-sandbox.note: Sandbox namespace for controlled budget proofs. No real payment method is ever attached to it; the only tools reachable under MONEY_SPEND are mock/sandbox tools. The three limits deliberately differ so the hierarchy is observable: a single request is capped at 5, one mission at 8, the project day at 10.
